title: Fewer ways for the town to get stuck
lines: Leaving a camp or the town just as you arrive now takes you back. Before, the page stopped until it was loaded again.
Going to a camp straight from the Works no longer has you walk back into town unseen.

more.head: Also fixed
points: With your camp open on two pages, a thing set out on one is no longer moved or put away by the other in its place.
A caller leaving your camp goes, even if you set something down in their way.
